text.name: AUKUS
text.rules: Record "pact". LIO spends 1 point on actions. At the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point on actions.
text.history: Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States announced the AUKUS security partnership on 15 September 2021, including a plan for Australian nuclear-powered submarines; Australia cancelled a French submarine contract the same day.
